verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Pigment has reporting and dashboard tools (pigment-docs-19, pigment-docs-28) and an Analyst Agent that builds reports. None of it documents exporting reports to slides, PDF, or spreadsheet formats. Open APIs and the MCP server are integration building blocks, not a documented report-export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can export reports to slides, PDF, or spreadsheet formats
